steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Knighteater miniature on the space designated on the diagram. To determine facing direction, look at the bottom card from the Minor Mortis deck. If the arrow in the lower left corner points ↑ or ↓, Knighteater is facing ↓. If the arrow points ← or →, Knighteater is facing ←.

Additional Setup: Depending on the Kingdom, take the Iron Confines (Principality of Stone) or Adaptable (Sunken Kingdom) Trait card. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).

Monster Positioning: Put numbered base rings on all Panzergeist miniatures. Randomly place Panzergeist miniatures numbered 1–10 on the spaces designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows. Important: Some Panzergeists are placed on Column Terrain tiles. Then, place all (10) BP cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–10 on the Mob track.
Additional Setup: Place 10 Armor tokens on the Board on spaces designated on the diagram. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).

notes: Note that some miniatures and tokens are placed on Terrain tiles!

steps: Monster Positioning: Place 8 BP 1 and 2 BP 2 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–10 on the Mob track. Put randomly chosen numbered base rings on 4 Firstman Lictor Hunter miniatures. Then, place those numbered Firstman Lictor Hunters miniatures on the spaces designated on the diagram and all other Firstman Lictor Hunter miniatures on spaces designated as Decoys (marked with the letter D) on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows.
Additional Setup: Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any). Set aside all Battle Tactics cards not used in this Clash.

steps: Monster Positioning: Put numbered base rings on all Ratwolf miniatures. Randomly place Ratwolf miniatures numbered 1–4 on the spaces designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows. Then, place 4 BP 1 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–4 on the Mob track.

Additional Setup: Depending on the Kingdom, take the Parasite Bed (Principality of Stone) or Bile and Poison (Sunken Kingdom) Trait card. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
